await (async (page) => {const base='https://staging.haven.digipomps.org/skeleton-parity/form/api';const get=async()=>await(await page.request.get(base+'/state')).json();const title=page.getByPlaceholder('Type a deterministic title');const body=page.getByPlaceholder('Type deterministic multiline content');const before=await get();await title.fill('Parity night 2026-09-15');await body.fill('First line — synthetic parity test.
